craft_evidence.owned: yes, evidenced: "INSIDE OUR USA FACTORY" factory-tour page (materials, preparation, construction, finishing); the Portland factory store sits at the factory site (counts return)
craft_evidence.makers: own factory for the USA-made boots and apparel; imported product makers not named
craft_evidence.madein: 46/46 styles state a country of origin (14 United States)
craft_evidence.heritage: dated: "EST. 1932" in the logo; Charles Danner "came west" to the Pacific Northwest (/about-danner); founding town not stated
craft_evidence.process: yes: factory tour walks through material preparation, construction and finishing; recrafting (resoling) service (/recrafting)
craft_evidence.reasoning: Danner shows its own USA factory and documents the stages of making, and the apparel pages state the country of origin on every style. A large share of the range is imported from unnamed factories, so the owned making does not cover it all.
